WORDS: Mrs. W. H. Olinger, pub.1936. MUSIC: Andrew L. Byers, pub.1936. Public Domain.

Shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight. Ex. 33:13; Psa. 25:4-5 Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.... and he shall direct thy paths. Pr. 3:5-6; Jn. 5:30
